# MCU Uploader: Dependencies

## Dependencies

* [avr toolchain](https://www.microchip.com/en-us/tools-resources/develop/microchip-studio/gcc-compilers)
* [avrdude](https://github.com/avrdudes/avrdude)

## Directory Structure

```txt
vendor/
├── avr-win32-toolchain/
│   ├── avr/
│   ├── bin/
│   ├── doc/
│   ├── include/
│   ├── info/
│   ├── lib/
│   ├── libexec/
│   ├── man/
│   ├── share/
│   └── x86_64-w64-mingw32/
│
└── avrdude-win32/
    ├── avrdude.conf
    ├── avrdude.exe
    └── avrdude.pdb
```
